label: Crest
description: A centered identity, with a logo slot or initials above the company.

label: Divider
description: Two groups split by a fine vertical rule at forty percent.

label: Letterhead
description: A left-aligned company heading, personal details and a quiet contact footer.

label: Monogram
description: An oversized initial with a compact right-aligned information block.

label: Frame
description: A double hairline frame around a centered, type-only identity.

label: Band
description: A 0.4 inch edge band made from spaced one-tone rules. Remaining text is flush left.

label: Scan
description: Left-aligned details beside a QR slot with a reserved four-module quiet zone.

label: Signature
description: A large script name, with a spaced title and one centered contact line.

label: Membership
description: A member name, membership number and renewal date.

label: Gift card
description: A clear gift value with a recipient and redemption contact.

label: Referral
description: A referral name and a single next step.

label: Warranty
description: An installation record and a service contact, with no implied coverage terms.

label: Specification
description: Three plain specification rows under a clear equipment heading.

label: Loyalty
description: Six outlined visit circles, ready for later marking.

label: If found
description: A clear return contact for a bag or set of keys.

label: Coordinates
description: A place, coordinates and a date, all on one centered axis.
